name: resisc45
description: RESISC45 is a remote sensing image scene classification benchmark containing 31,500 images across 45 scene classes (aerial/satellite imagery). It measures a model's ability to classify high-resolution overhead images into semantic scene categories. The dataset is used to evaluate image representation and classification methods in the remote sensing / geospatial vision domain.
reputation: Widely used and well-cited in remote sensing and aerial scene classification research as a standard benchmark.
